title: Build vs buy: cloud platform
transcript:
Platform Engineering Lead: Alright everyone, let's dive into the cloud infrastructure decision. I've gathered some options and thoughts on the table.

SRE: Before we start, I wanted to bring up the idea of a hybrid approach with Alibaba Cloud for certain regions.

Platform Engineering Lead: I understand your proposal, SRE, but I believe the costs associated with such a solution might outweigh the benefits, given our current budget constraints.

CTO: Let's table that for now and focus on the main decision at hand. SRE, do you have any concerns about staying with AWS?

SRE: No, I don't have any fundamental concerns about AWS. It's been a reliable choice for us so far.

Finance Partner: But isn't there a risk that maintaining the status quo might lead to complacency and missed opportunities for cost savings or improved performance?

Platform Engineering Lead: I acknowledge your concerns, Finance Partner, but AWS offers the best fit for our needs due to existing integration with our existing systems. The time-to-value with AWS is minimal compared to building or purchasing a new platform.

CTO: That makes sense, Platform Engineering Lead. I think we can agree that staying with AWS is the best choice for now.

Finance Partner: Alright, but we'll need to review AWS costs quarterly to ensure they don't become prohibitive as our operations scale.

CTO: Agreed. SRE, Platform Engineering Lead, let's ensure we have regular check-ins to monitor costs and address any potential issues.

SRE: Understood, CTO. I'll make sure to schedule those meetings.

CTO: Great. With that said, I think we've reached a decision: Status quo maintained: continue using AWS for cloud infrastructure. SRE, Platform Engineering Lead, shall we proceed with the necessary steps?

Platform Engineering Lead: Absolutely, CTO. I'll oversee the implementation and ensure a smooth transition.

CTO: Excellent. Thank you all for your contributions. Let's get back to work.

(Off-topic exchange)

SRE: By the way, I heard there's a new coffee shop opening down the street. Anyone interested in grabbing a cup later?

Finance Partner: I'd love to, SRE. Let's make it a team outing.

Platform Engineering Lead: Sounds good to me. Let's take a break after this meeting.

Meeting Summary: Cloud Infrastructure Decision

Maintained status quo with AWS, owing to its seamless integration with existing systems and minimal time-to-value compared to alternative platforms. Transition to Google Cloud Platform was deferred due to concerns over potential integration issues and a steep learning curve. The team will assess AWS costs quarterly as operations scale, with a focus on ensuring they remain feasible. No further action items discussed in this meeting.
